run1_recheck.note: Same steps as run 1 (run_6). Canvas is now centred with even bars: 1280x720 gives 100 px left / 100 px right, 1920x1080 gives 150 / 150, 800x1000 gives 233 above / 234 below, 640x427 has no bars. Page background is the game's brown rgb(46,38,36). START works by mouse at every size. Shots: run2/a1_1280x720_menu.jpg, run2/a1_800x1000_results.jpg.

Same steps as run 1 (run_7). With document.body.style.zoom = '2' (and with html zoom 1.5) the canvas no longer spills off the top-left: it keeps its fitted rect (0,240,480x320 at 480x800; 0,0,960x640 at 960x640). Mouse clicks on START and on the LEVEL 1 card both work (Title -> Menu -> Chat). The game cancels the CSS zoom and refits instead of getting bigger. The commit title says 'makes the game bigger', but the code comment says it refits. FIT already fills the window, so there is no room to grow. Real Ctrl+ zoom (emulated as 480x320 at DPR 2) also just refits. Shots: run2/a2_zoom2_480x800_menu.jpg, run2/a2_zoom2_960x640_after_level.jpg.
Locked badge text now uses C.locked (#c9b9ad in High contrast, about 7.8:1 on the badge plate, up from about 3.5:1). DOWNTOWN / LOCKED reads clearly at 960x640. Shot: run2/b_crop_locked_badge_hc.png.

Names grew only slightly: Outcome reaction names went from 16px to 17px, and Ending roll-call names are 18px. Chat names are 20px. In High contrast, Liam's colour darkens from #9a6b14 to #906412, about 4.6:1 on the cream panel. Brooke #86691a is about 4.55:1. Both now pass 4.5:1, barely. The names are still small Jersey 10 text in friend colours, though easier to read than in run 1. Shots: run2/b_crop_outcome_names_hc.png, run2/f_ending2.jpg.

With High contrast on (the run 1 setup), the Options PREVIEW still shows a short dark line from the end of 'LIAM' running right along the name's baseline, above the bubble's own top edge. It shows at DPR 2, 4 and 8. With High contrast off there is no bubble outline and no line. The fix (drawPreviewBubble: beginPath before strokeRoundedRect) did not remove it. Shots: run2/c_crop_preview_liam_8x.png, run2/c_crop_preview_liam_high.png, run2/c_crop_preview_liam_normal.png (clean, for comparison). The same artefact also appears in the real Chat, see AX-06.

bugs.title: High contrast: a starred chat line gets a stray dark line from the speaker's name across the top of the bubble
bugs.where: Chat, any level from chapter 2 (seen on level_07)
steps: Open ?scene=Chat&level=level_07 and wait for a few lines
Press up to pick Liam's line 'got it. in, eat, out...' and press S to star it (a mouse click on the star does the same)
Look at the LIAM name above the bubble
bugs.expected: The name sits above the orange-bordered bubble with nothing joining them, as with High contrast off.
bugs.actual: A thin dark line runs from the end of 'LIAM' to the right along the name's baseline, just above the bubble's orange top edge. The name looks underlined and the bubble looks double-edged. It disappears when the line is unstarred, and does not appear with High contrast off. This is the same artefact as AX-05 in the Options preview: the starred bubble's strokeRoundedRect (ChatScene.js around line 466) seems to reuse the path from an earlier draw.
bugs.frequency: every time (2 of 2 runs, DPR 2 and DPR 3)

not_bugs: No page or console errors on any screen, size or zoom. The only console warnings came from my own contrast-measuring canvas.
Animations Off: 0 active tweens on every screen and right after starring a line; the corner note and unlock cards just appear.

Title (new picture): the yellow tagline measures about 2.8:1 against the sky and awnings behind it, but its dark drop shadow keeps it legible up close. The 'enter: start · m: music' footer over the table is readable. Worth watching, not reported.
Scrapbook locked tabs: the grey '?' text sits under the badge icon and is not visible; locked tabs show a neutral icon and give no hint.
Friends locked tabs '???' (white 26px bold on the grey tab, about 3.9:1) pass the large-text 3:1 rule.
Friends 'met 0/6' after seeding progress without lets-eat-opened-v1 is caused by my seeded save (met = opened a level), not a bug.

layoutProblems hits checked: chat 'off screen' and header overlaps are scrolled lines inside the masked chat panel; Credits hits are its scroll list; Friends stamp '2 / LEVELS TOGETHER' is by design; Results review vs '↓ scroll for more' / RECOMMEND THIS is the scroll cut-off; Ending part 1 header overlap is a masked scrolled line.
Text size Large at 640x427 and 800x1000: Chat, Results, Outcome and Options fit with nothing cut off; reviews scroll.
Starring is never colour-only: filled star, orange border and Notebook entry.
Every map key (S, F, O, C) opens its screen and Esc returns to the map, in High contrast.

I didn't finish a full normal-route level_01 pass: after 'a: show all' and 3 Enters the chat was still on its last lines. Speed was not my focus; Results and Outcome were covered through the dev shortcuts.
feedback: The fixes help a lot: the game is centred, zoom no longer breaks clicking and the locked districts read well. High contrast still leaves some see-through panels (Credits, chat background art) and small tinted names, and the stray outline line now also shows up on starred chat lines.
